slots.notes: fullscreen looping autoplay/muted background video behind the entire hero, object-cover
scannable QR-code image inside the accent-tinted 'Try Now' card; rounded-lg object-cover, square

mechanic: static fullscreen looping-video hero with a glass-blur nav and centered content whose heading, subtitle, and QR card stagger in via fade-up (cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1)) on cascading delays, plus a slide-down/up mobile menu.
techDelivery: React + TypeScript + Tailwind CSS (config fontFamily extend) + Lucide React icons; fonts via index.html (Qanelas-Heavy CDN + Inter Google Fonts), keyframes in index.css.
reskinNotes: Accent green is baked into Tailwind arbitrary classes (bg-[#4CAF50]/hover:bg-[#43A047]) rather than a token, so re-skinning requires find-replace across markup; all copy (brand split into qanelas-italic 'Zipwire.' + inter 'Dev', headline, subtitle, nav links, 'Try Now', 'Get It Today', 'EN'/'DE') is hardcoded in JSX; Qanelas-Heavy is a font-metric-dependent display face (uppercase, leading-[0.95], tracking-tight, sizes up to 110px) so substitute fonts may reflow the headline; bg/fg grays come from Tailwind gray-900/700/600/200 utilities, not declared hex tokens.
